downloadProbe.redactions: Only HTTP status, media type and provider error code retained; request ID, headers and unrelated response fields omitted.

checks: retry prepares in the same window
configuration layout and byte pin claims wait for receipt
same-project public versions filtered by device
new download gets its own SHA
late cancelled source and metadata results discarded
cancel during batch file inspection waits for lock release before retry

validation.browserMethod: Headless Chromium via tracked Playwright CLI; injected Serial and esptool fixtures; no physical USB access.
validation.limits: These checks validate download/error handling, catalog metadata and browser workflows. The replacement official firmware was not downloaded or executed on a simulator or physical device.

commands: cargo clippy --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p esp32sim-wasm --features jit-tests -- -D warnings
